clinical_changes: Source revised for plain clinical language and iCCA focality clarification; export preserves source content except hosting and evidence-access URLs.
documentation_changes: Reviewed all 46 transplant decisions and 45 linked discussion questions for explicit treatment, transplant-listing and MELD-exception language. Added next actions for every decision result, including conditional AFP treatment choices, reassessment after treatment, and best supportive care. NCCN sources cite original PDF pages. Existing selection thresholds and matching rules are retained; Word documents keep their separately dated wording. No recording, signatures, export or persistent storage.
interface_changes: Added a pinned, layered decision trail to all 12 roadmaps and seven transplant pathways. Only the first transplant finding is preselected as a labeled example; each later finding and action starts unanswered. Changing an earlier finding clears later questions and decisions. Selection criteria expand inline, explanations use information panels, and cautions remain visible. Supplemental safety questions join the same trail; treatment and high-risk alternatives remain available when a standard path stops. Desktop and phone checks cover 46 decisions and 103 roadmap topics. Clinical matching rules, source evidence and orange high-risk documents are retained.
high_risk_interface: Orange-labeled reviews at relevant standard decisions, with selection criteria, study evidence and PDF/TMC access. Standard matching rules unchanged.
contextual_routing: Answer-specific review options appear inside matching next actions after ordinary care. Clarification selectors distinguish conflated findings. Closed expansions remain explanatory; HCC-B4 remains research reference only. Earlier adverse findings carry forward and upstream edits clear dependent choices. All 46 decisions and 21 reviews checked with B/C mapping reviews and D/E clinical reviews; no selection threshold or source evidence changed.
streamlining: One current next-step result; unmatched or superseded results are reference-only. Distinct treatments keep separate conditional actions. Closed local protocols and inactive study proposals do not produce forward protocol buttons. Smaller sticky navigation and a collapsible mobile overview. Three rounds of external B/C/D/E review, with coverage limits recorded. No clinical thresholds, sources or matching rules changed.
afp_review: Separate AFP-related clinical and individual allocation review at allocation, treatment, listing and waitlist decisions. This is not enrollment in the beyond-UNOS tumor-burden pilot; standard AFP thresholds and existing study criteria are unchanged.
evidence_organization: Status, proposed position and next action precede open criteria. Searchable study summaries pair results with limitations and retain population and time-origin wording. One access record per source within each review; authority types, review coverage and approval limits are explicit. No selection criteria or matching rules changed.
explanation_display: Floating info panel; phone tap/optional hold
